what: A pill button (Menu) hidden at the top right appears in .5s once the hero has been scrolled past (when the top edge of the after element touches the top of the screen), and hides again and closes the panel when you scroll back (always visible on phones at 760px and below). On press the button label swaps Menu→Close with an overlapping change, the middle of the three lines shrinks to 0 and the top and bottom lines bend into an X (.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,.56,.99)). Below the button, a translucent menu panel with a 5px blur waits .5s and then turns on over .5s, and on close it also waits .5s before turning off. The button uses difference blending, so it stays visible anywhere, over photos or dark bands.

options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Pill button — contains label (two copies of text) and icon (three lines)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Blurred panel under the button — clicking a link inside closes it
options.after: When the top edge of this selector reaches the top of the screen, the button appears (default none = always visible)
options.narrow: Always visible at or below this width (px), default 760
options.--fx-dur·--fx-ease·--fx-wait: Change length, curve and the time the panel waits (CSS variables), default .5s·cubic-bezier(0,0,.56,.99)·.5s — for frequently opened apps use --fx-wait: 0
options.fx:open·fx:close: Fired from the element on open and close

use: …

from.where: shared.js .mk-btn and .mk-dnav (original drawer-nav-btn and site-header__drawer-nav — when the top edge of #addFixed touches the top of the screen it becomes btnFixed, panel 20rem, top 6.5rem, blur 5px)
